items.note: ok the KITCHEN. double-height barrel-vaulted ceiling, a fireplace next to the breakfast table, AND a wine cellar with a tasting room downstairs. 2.3 acres. i can't.
a 1928 bronxville house with a stone wall and a whole perennial garden out front. it's giving storybook!!
bronxville!! five bedrooms, would look SO good with a wreath on the door.

items.title: the tape measure gag
items.creator: @ihorofficial
items.body: someone holds a tape measure up to something tiny and reacts like it's ENORMOUS. so stupid, 18.2M views, i laughed.

items.title: the easy group dance
items.creator: @sophia.kumbartzky
items.body: friends learn one simple move together and end in a chill pose. it's at 29.7M views because literally anyone can do it.

items.title: #starbucksholidaydrinks is everywhere
items.body: red cups are back, and the holiday drink hashtag is one of the most-viewed on tiktok this week at 59.6M. very festive.

items.title: the snack-break dance
items.creator: @jujuonthat333

items.title: tweens still want toys and games
items.body: YPulse says games and toys are still at the top of tweens' holiday wish lists, followed by consoles, phones and money.

items.title: the #1 tiktok sound is a hiking video
items.body: the top trending sound on tiktok worldwide today is an original audio from a pacific northwest hiking account, getting 40K+ new videos a day.

items.title: "lore"
items.body: means the backstory behind something. "what's the lore on this?" = what's the backstory here.
